reference_role: REFERENCE IMAGE = the character's FACE, exactly as drawn: two solid round dots (eyes) joined by one single smile curve (mouth). This IS the character's head - there is no head outline, no circle, no nose, no eyebrows, no pupils, no extra facial features. Reproduce these two dots and the connecting curve faithfully in every image, the same relative size and spacing, drawn in the same ink as the body. Only the props and the body change; the face never changes except where the scene says so. CRITICAL: do NOT draw a circle, oval or outline for the head. Where a stick figure's head would be there is only empty white space containing the two dots and the curve, exactly like the reference. A head circle is a failed image.
style: Minimalist hand-drawn stick figure webcomic sticker, bold deep-navy ink line art (#0B2545, no black, no other colours except a single tiny accent when named), doodle aesthetic, isolated on a solid white background, cartoon motion lines, hand-drawn text caption in the same navy ink, relatable sarcastic office humor, clean die-cut sticker design with a thick white border, high contrast, 2D vector graphic. The character 'Rumi' is a simple stick figure whose head is ONLY the reference face (two dots + one smile curve floating where the head would be). Pure #FFFFFF white background edge to edge (not grey, not off-white). Square 1:1 composition, character large and centered, caption in a clear hand-lettered style either above or below, spelled EXACTLY as given, nothing else written anywhere.
negative: no head circle, no extra eyes, no pupils, no eyebrows, no nose, no teeth, no realistic shading, no grey fills, no gradients, no colours other than navy ink on white (plus the one named accent), no speech bubble unless named, no logos, no watermark, no misspelled or extra words, no border cropping.
